_about: The Grid tool (/grid): the figures the page prints, each with its check key and value. The network group is the page's own code (network_figures.mjs) on the snapshot named here; the carbon group is the rows of carbon_intensity_monthly the Clean tab's monthly block names, read from the tables named here; the ask group is the Ask panel's stored answers, as the panel shows them on the day. Written by figures_of_the_page.py; replicate.py recomputes each figure without the page's code, from the snapshot and the tables.
